# Repository Instructions for Copilot Agents

All rules for AI agents in this repository live in **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)**.
They are mandatory for any prompt that changes repository files.

Before you finish a task, follow the end-of-task checklist in AGENTS.md §7:

- tree file;
- the docs-accuracy-audit skill;
- UI text in all 17 languages;
- `:app:testDebugUnitTest`, `:app:assembleDebug` and `:app:detekt`;
- the PASS / FAIL / N/A audit table in your summary.

The plan and the status of each phase are in [docs/ROADMAP.md](../docs/ROADMAP.md).
